'''Water Kitten''' is a {{type|Cat}} [[enemy]] found in {{ch|The Sewers}}, though it may also very rarely be encountered in {{ch|The Alley}}.

== Behavior ==
Some Water Kittens may spawn in a level hidden from view, and will pop out once a unit walks adjacent to them.

It is a Melee attacker that will attempt to close the distance to its enemies.

=== Notes ===
* Will leave {{tile|Water|Water Tiles}} in its path.
* Can walk through water unimpeded.
* When damaged, it will run away from the source.

=== Tips ===
* Hiding Water Kittens do not have a turn order, and combat can end early without them appearing.
* Certain effects such as {{p|Omniscience}} and {{mut|ears.316}} will cause the hiding Water Kittens to have their locations marked at combat start with exclamation marks.

== Trivia ==
* Water kittens are equipped with two unique [[Enemy Items|Items]] that give them the Banana peel hat and slime neckpiece.
** Their unique items are visually similar to the {{i|Sludge Hat}} and {{i|Sludge Necklace}}.
* Their hiding mechanic is implemented via a unique [[Trap]] that cannot be spawned by the player.
